scout.gate: Validate selected paths, expand with deterministic keyword search on missing required concepts.

planner.gate: Supervisor or deterministic assertions must validate behavior semantics; file/schema compliance is insufficient.

coder.gate: Never apply automatically; require patch extraction, git apply check, allowed-file check, and focused test. After rejection, use Codex takeover unless running an explicit qualification experiment.

reviewer.gate: Use 14B for filesystem/security review; no single tested reviewer passed both defect classes.

escalation_coder.gate: Do not use in the default flow. Qualification experiments require multiple cases plus apply/path/exact-test/revision/diff-size hard gates.
